intro: A bowl of mee kari is roughly 650 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the santan curry broth and the yellow noodles.
diet: Yes, just control the broth. Santan and curry oil push the calories up. The chicken is great for protein. Once a week with half the broth is fine for most people.
tips: Don't slurp all the broth. Eat the toppings and noodles only.
Choose chicken breast, not the skin-on parts.
Ask for extra veg like long beans or brinjal.

swap.name: Mee sup ayam
swap.why: Clear soup without santan. Same protein, much lower calories.

faq.a: Depends on the shop. Most are medium spicy, and sambal is usually served on the side.

faq.q: Is mee kari okay for breakfast?
faq.a: Lots of Malaysians eat it for breakfast. It's heavy though, so keep lunch lighter.

faq.q: Can I keep leftover curry broth for the next day?
faq.a: Yes. Store it in the fridge and reheat until boiling. Many say it tastes better on day two.
